in_sanskrit.name: Babloo
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Little one
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Babloo एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। A name derived from the Hindi word 'Bablu', meaning 'little monkey'. This name is often given to babies born in the monkey year of the Hindu zodiac.

in_tamil.name: Babloo
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Little one
in_tamil.long_meaning: Babloo ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। A name derived from the Hindi word 'Bablu', meaning 'little monkey'. This name is often given to babies born in the monkey year of the Hindu zodiac.

in_telugu.name: Babloo
in_telugu.long_meaning: Babloo ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। A name derived from the Hindi word 'Bablu', meaning 'little monkey'. This name is often given to babies born in the monkey year of the Hindu zodiac.
